title: Floating-Point Robustness in Parametric Surface Continuous Collision Detection: From Algorithm to Benchmarking
venue: ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH 2026), Vol. 45, No. 4, Article 141
abstract: 连续碰撞检测（CCD）在仿真与建模中对准确识别物体碰撞至关重要。鲁棒 CCD 技术在三角网格上已经成熟，但对参数曲面而言，由于其表示复杂性与更高的算法敏感性，浮点鲁棒性仍是开放挑战。本文提出首个面向参数曲面的浮点鲁棒 CCD 框架。基于时间相关包含法（TDIBM），我们引入一种全新的误差分解策略，将系数误差与算术误差分离，从而实现结构化分析与安全保证。为严格地基准化鲁棒性，我们通过反演 CCD 流程构建了一个基于有理算术的数据集：从规定的碰撞结果生成精确真值数据集，既覆盖典型场景，也覆盖近退化用例。我们用该基准评测多种 CCD 算法以提供深入分析。我们的方法与数据集共同为分析、基准化并改进参数曲面 CCD 的浮点鲁棒性奠定了全面基础。
abstract_en: Continuous Collision Detection is essential in simulation and modeling for accurately identifying object collisions. While robust CCD techniques have matured for triangle meshes, ensuring floating-point robustness for parametric surfaces remains an open challenge. We present the first floating-point-robust CCD framework for parametric surfaces, built on TDIBM, with a novel error decomposition separating coefficient and arithmetic errors, plus a rational-arithmetic ground-truth benchmark built by inverting the CCD process.
nature: Algorithm + Dataset / Benchmark (theoretical error analysis + system design)
